xss_injection_attempts.trigger: detection of html/script tags in input headers or URL search parameters

protection_advice: Ensure HTTP Response headers contain: Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'
Enable X-Frame-Options: DENY to prevent Clickjacking overlays
Inject sanitization routines on any contact form inputs to strip HTML characters

blue_dot.description: Normal user activity logs (scroll progress, section entry transitions, page element clicks)

green_dot.description: Key interaction events (opening project details, successful owner auth logs, downloading resume)

red_dot.description: Critical security warnings (text copying, tab switching, failed login credentials, hacker script URL attempts)

export_destination.instructions: Place your downloaded telemetry reports ('telemetry_report_<timestamp>.json') in this 'data(Security)' folder to maintain a secure offline audit log of your portfolio activity.
